commits.author: ccason
commits.subject: Update golangci-lint-action to v7 for golangci-lint v2
commits.body:
golangci-lint-action v6 rejects golangci-lint v2 with "invalid version string
'v2.13.2' ... you must update to golangci-lint-action v7", failing every CI run.
v7 is the release that supports the v2 line we pin.

files.diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
index ad0c9d1..9c39a61 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -25,7 +25,7 @@ jobs:
       - run: go test ./... -coverprofile=coverage.out -covermode=atomic
       - run: go tool cover -func=coverage.out | tail -1
 
-      - uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v6
+      - uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v7
         with:
           version: v2.13.2
files.head:
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # golangci-lint's own PR-diff mode and gremlins --diff need history

      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "1.26"

      - run: go build ./...
      - run: go vet ./...
      - run: go test ./... -coverprofile=coverage.out -covermode=atomic
      - run: go tool cover -func=coverage.out | tail -1

      - uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v7
        with:
          version: v2.13.2

  bench:
    # Advisory: records numbers in the log, never fails the build. A
    # regression here is something a human reads, not a gate — the same
    # posture Redline's own coverage pane takes toward a number with no
    # threshold attached.
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "1.26"
      - run: go test ./... -bench=. -benchtime=10x -run='^$'

  mutate:
    # Advisory, diff-scoped, pull_request only: mutation-tests only the
    # lines a PR touched against its base, so this stays fast regardless of
    # module size. See `make mutate` for the same command locally.
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "1.26"
      - run: go install github.com/go-gremlins/gremlins/cmd/gremlins@latest
      - run: gremlins unleash . --diff="origin/${{ github.base_ref }}" --timeout-coefficient=10
        continue-on-error: true
